ad.name: 长城炼金术-股票开户炒股

evidence.note: The advertised app '长城炼金术-股票开户炒股' is developed by China Great Wall Securities (长城证券) and is a stock brokerage / securities trading app used for opening stock accounts and trading equities. While both SPDB and Changcheng Securities are financial institutions in China, they serve fundamentally different functions: SPDB is a commercial bank for deposits, transfers, loans, and credit cards, whereas this app is a securities broker for stock trading. There is no name match, no shared developer, and no direct functional overlap. The only link is the very broad 'finance' category.
